Why Dattivox exists

It started with a plumber.

Sergio needed to book an appointment with his plumber. The plumber was working and couldn't pick up. He called back later — Sergio couldn't answer. They kept missing each other, call after call.

It raised an obvious question: after decades of digital transformation, why does getting help by phone still depend on two people being free at exactly the same moment?

Dattivox is the answer to that question.

Built by a small team in Brussels.

Dattico builds systems that turn data into conversations. Dattivox is where that comes to life.
